dealAnnounced: 2007 (12-year naming rights deal announced; Atlantic Health Jets Training Center opened 2008 in Florham Park, NJ; partnership still active as of 2025 per atlantichealth.org)

financials.source: Form 990 (EIN 65-1301877 group return) via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer for revenue ($4,763,861,023), expenses ($4,459,713,866), and net income ($304,147,157) for FY2024. AHS Hospital Corp. audited consolidated financial statements (Dec 31, 2024) for total assets (~$6.35B) and derived total liabilities (~$2.66B from $6.35B assets minus $3.69B net assets). Note: EIN 22-3110087 in this file maps to Shark Research Institute per ProPublica; Atlantic Health System files under EIN 22-3380375 (main entity) and 65-1301877 (group return).

balanceSheetWealth.investmentPortfolioSource: AHS Hospital Corp. audited consolidated financial statements, Dec 31, 2024. Total assets whose use is limited: $2,872,830,000 (up from $2,659,047,000 in 2023). Composition: mutual funds $1.54B, fixed income funds $649M, equity securities $416M. Noncurrent portion: $2,804,958,000. Separately, long-term investments and other assets: $601,600,000.
balanceSheetWealth.realEstateSource: Not separately disclosed in audited financial statements; Atlantic Health System operates five hospitals and numerous outpatient facilities across Morris, Union, Sussex, Warren, and Passaic counties in northern New Jersey
balanceSheetWealth.notes: Total net assets: $3,690,000,000 (Dec 31, 2024), growing to $4,170,000,000 (Dec 31, 2025) per audited statements. Total assets: $6,350,000,000 (2024), $6,820,000,000 (2025). System employs approximately 22,000 people as of 2024.

bondDebt.largestIssue: NJHCFFA Revenue Bonds Series 2016 (tax-exempt refunding, maturities through 2041, rates 3.00%-5.00%)
bondDebt.issuerAuthority: New Jersey Health Care Facilities Financing Authority (NJHCFFA)
bondDebt.source: AHS Hospital Corp. audited consolidated financial statements, Dec 31, 2024. Long-term debt net of current portion: $1,366,897,000; current portion: $19,136,000; total: $1,386,033,000. Includes $50,000,000 Bank of America taxable term loan at 5.60% maturing Dec 1, 2028. Average bond interest rate: 4.21%. As of Q2 2025 (unaudited): $1,364,054,000 net of current portion. Series 2016 refunded earlier Series 2008A and 2011 bonds (originally ~$450M outstanding across five active series per 2015 NJHCFFA minutes).

relatedOrganizations.source: Schedule R; Atlantic Health System public disclosures; full subsidiary listing and EINs require verification from most recent Form 990 Schedule R

executiveComp.source: Form 990 Part VII (EIN 65-1301877 group return) FY2024 via ProPublica. Reportable compensation: $9,720,812; related organization compensation: $0; other compensation (benefits, deferred comp): $1,810,496; total: $11,531,308. Base vs. bonus breakdown requires Schedule J. Prior year (FY2023): reportable $8,373,068 + other $1,137,448 = $9,510,516 total. Predecessor Joseph Trunfio received $10,690,000 in 2012 per NJ.com. Gragnolati announced retirement Dec 3, 2024; successor Saad Ehtisham named as next President & CEO per NJBIZ. Earlier years: $4,214,047 (2019 per Crain's); $2,715,543 (2017 per Paddock Post).

communityBenefit.source: No specific dollar amounts found in web searches; Schedule H data for EIN 65-1301877 or 22-3380375 not returned by ProPublica search results. NJ Charity Care program: full coverage for income up to 200% FPL, partial coverage 200%-300% FPL per Atlantic Health plain-language summary. Uninsured discount available below 500% FPL. AHA reports national average community benefit at 15.1% of total expenses (2022). Atlantic Health publishes community benefit reports and CHNAs on its website; dollar amounts require direct Form 990 Schedule H review.

taxAdvantage.notes: Atlantic Health System operates five hospitals and numerous outpatient facilities across Morris, Union, Sussex, Warren, and Passaic counties in New Jersey, all property-tax-exempt under NJ nonprofit hospital exemption. New Jersey corporate business tax rate is 11.5% for income over $10M. Federal income tax foregone on system net income would be substantial. Tax-exempt bond interest subsidy applies to outstanding NJHCFFA-issued debt. Property tax foregone requires county-by-county assessor data aggregation.
